## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
Rotation from Growth to Cyclicals. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation (9/11) and cyclicals/materials + industrials among the leaders; Major Divergence present (many large-cap techs showing 1W vs 1M conflict) — watch for trend confirmation.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate lead: CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY; PLD (noted in news) showing strength. Materials lead: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Technology showing rotation: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging (1W weak, 1M strong) with exhaustion signals: XOM (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION, SLB (1W: -5.49% | 1M: +3.24%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, GM (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.49%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY, BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — gives rotation breadth, not a narrow tech rally.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -7.58% | 1M: -15.38%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -5.49% | 1M: +3.24%) CORRECTION, TMUS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and select utilities/consumer staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Divergence: Major — multiple large-cap techs (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) on 1W rebounds while 1M remains negative, so treat moves as tactical not full rotations yet.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed/rotating with many short-term bounces: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -7.83%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W positive and showing internal rotation between legacy software and chip names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautious/neutral rotation: JPM (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND. Financials 1W mildly positive as a group; look for confirmation of sustained leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive but mixed: PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY, ISRG (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare showing idiosyncratic catalysts (FDA news) while broader sector rotation favors cyclicals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to cyclical/value names showing durable 1W+1M strength (INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, select materials/industrial plays NEM, FCX, BA in RECOVERY). Reduce exposure to consumer discretionary and troubled staples (NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%) BELOW TREND). Style: Cyclical/Value tilt within a Rotation regime; major divergence suggests tactical sizing.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, PLD (news +65) monitor for follow-through. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -2.07% | 1M: -12.28%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials and Real Estate (both 1W leaders, watch earnings/catalysts). BEARISH: Energy (1W weakness, 1M strength = trend exhaustion) and Consumer Discretionary (notable weakness).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
INTC continuation: re-test/follow-through above this week’s breakout zone (monitor near recent swing high) — ABOVE TREND confirmation would need further 1W strength. NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY — watch for reclaim of recent monthly pivot to confirm trend turn. NKE downside momentum — watch for support failure that would reinforce BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): FDA approval for Foundayo oral obesity pill; price RECOVERY LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) — sentiment confirming short-term strength. WBD (+85): Warner/Netflix deal headlines; watch WBD (not in SP100 listing here) but related Netflix pressure — NFLX (1W: +5.72% | 1M: 0.00%) ambiguous. PLD (+65): Beat-and-raise; PLD price strength aligns with sector Real Estate leadership.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABBV (-80): Tariff headlines create material downside risk while ABBV (not fully detailed here) should be watched; related pharma names PFE (-50) show mixed signals — PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND, so news is diverging. PYPL (-65): CEO exit/lawsuit risk — PYPL (not highlighted in key set) merits watch given sector sensitivity. NKE (-50): multiple target cuts; price is BELOW TREND NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) — sentiment confirms weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Cyclical/Value tilt supported by broad participation (Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive). INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND and materials/real estate names (NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY) are showing relative strength. Key risk: Major divergence across mega-cap techs (many 1W rebounds vs negative 1M) and mixed news sentiment (LLY bullish, ABBV/PYPL bearish) — watch for trend confirmation.
